EMPLOYEE ONBOARDING GUIDE (v1)
=============================

1. ARRIVE AT THE OFFICE (8:00 AM)
   - Report to the main reception on the 3rd floor.
   - Bring: Government-issued ID, signed offer letter, completed I-9 form.
   - You will receive: Employee badge, building access card, parking pass.

2. ORIENTATION (8:30 AM - 9:30 AM)
   - Meet HR in Conference Room A (3rd floor).
   - Review company policies and benefits overview.
   - Complete payroll and direct deposit forms.

3. IT SETUP (10:00 AM - 11:30 AM)
   - Pick up your laptop from IT (Room 3C-12).
   - Sign in with your temporary password (provided by IT).
   - Enroll in MFA for email and VPN (required).

4. TEAM INTRODUCTIONS (11:30 AM - 12:00 PM)
   - Meet your manager and team.
   - Confirm your first-week schedule.

5. LUNCH (12:00 PM - 1:00 PM)

6. SECURITY BRIEFING (1:00 PM - 1:30 PM)
   - Visitor escort rules.
   - Badge policy and restricted areas.

7. WORKSPACE SETUP (2:00 PM - 3:00 PM)
   - Set up your desk/workstation.
   - Install required software (IT will provide list).
   - Join team Slack channels.
   - Add yourself to team calendar.

8. END OF DAY CHECKOUT (4:45 PM)
   - Confirm you can access email and Slack.
   - Ask IT to verify VPN access if you will work remotely.
